title: Jacksonville tour, Mobile, Pelican band, Marable and Desvigne
summary: One long account: the road trip to Jacksonville, Mobile hotel work, return to New Orleans in 1926 with Bebe Ridgley's Pelican band, Suburban Gardens, Club Plantation, Fate Marable's boat, then Sidney Desvigne in 1930.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable
